Agent Name: Vegan_Food_Expert
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: After manually estimating distances, they acknowledged several restaurants (e.g., By Chloe at 185 Bleecker St ~0.3 miles, Peacefood Cafe at 41 E 11th St ~0.4 miles, Murray's Falafel & Grill at 261 6th Ave ~0.3 miles) were well beyond 1 block from Washington Square Park, yet still included them in the “Verified List.” This misapplication of the proximity constraint directly led to the wrong final solution. Additionally, they relied on outdated/incorrect venue status (e.g., “By Chloe” rebranded), compounding the inaccuracy.
